12196.html:
12196 vyā́tta 'opened (esp. of mouth)' MBh. 2. n. 'open jaws' AV. [Cf. vyādadāti. — √dā¹]
    1. Pa. vatta- 'opened wide (of mouth)'; Pk. vatta- 'open' (wrongly sanskritized as vyāpta- 'open' W.); Sh. bātṷ 'open'.
    2. S. vātu m. 'mouth', L. vāt m.; — Pa. Pk. vatta- n. prob. < vaktrá-.
    *vyāthayati 'leads astray' see vyáthatē.
